entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A powerful, long-lived white-aligned human nation on Aerona, Dominaria, devastated by the Phyrexian Invasion and reborn as New Benalia after the Mending.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Benalia lies.

entities.name: Torsten von Ursus
entities.description: The exiled knight from Wrenna who founded Benalia and left the Lost Edict.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: The church once banned in Benalia and later embraced as its official religion.

entities.name: Sheoltun Empire
entities.description: A militaristic expansionist nation whose collapse allowed Benalia to rise.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose specialized killers first victimized Benalia during the Invasion.

entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: Benalia's strongest and richest house, whose bloodline was prophesied to destroy Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: The Benalish leader at the Oyster Bay summit, compleated and killed by his daughter.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A young, ferocious knight and current leader of Clan Capashen who killed her compleated father.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: The Keldon leader at the Oyster Bay summit.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure who, with Teferi, revealed the New Phyrexian threat at the summit.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Karn, revealed the New Phyrexian threat.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Leader of the Serran troops supplied by the merchant lords of Orvada.

entities.name: Cerise D'Avenant
entities.description: Leader of Clan Avenant.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A group whose expansion corrupted Benalia's expanses; the Echoverse Capashens joined it.

entities.name: Council of Seven
entities.description: The ruling body of Benalia made up of the leaders of the seven houses.

entities.name: Lost Edict
entities.description: Torsten's legendary edict forbidding sole rule and dividing responsibility among seven clans.

entities.name: Compact of the Seven Pillars
entities.description: The agreement forged after the Mending laying out how power would be shared.

entities.name: Benalia City
entities.description: Benalia's capital, razed in the Invasion, a salt-choked ruin, and rebuilt in white limestone.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Benalia was first victimized and Benalia City razed in 4205 AR.

events.summary: Torsten von Ursus founds Benalia at the blighted city of Benfosa.
events.quote: The knight Torsten von Ursus , in exile since an evil mage conquered his homeland of Wrenna , founded Benalia at the spot of the blighted city of Benfosa

events.summary: Torsten dies leaving the Lost Edict forbidding a sole ruler.
events.quote: After succeeding in much of his goal, he died at the age of seventy-two, leaving behind the legendary Lost Edict

events.summary: Benalia is the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's killers during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion , Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers.

events.summary: Benalia City is razed at the invasion's peak and its people scattered.
events.quote: When the invasion reached its peak in 4205 AR , Benalia City was razed, and its people scattered.

events.summary: Benalia City is besieged by slivers and becomes a salt-choked ruin.
events.quote: What remained of Benalia City was besieged by slivers , and it became a salt-choked ruin.

events.summary: After the Mending the seven houses forge the Compact of the Seven Pillars.
events.quote: In the ruins of Benalia City, under the blessing of Serran priests , they forged the Compact of the Seven Pillars in emulation of the Lost Edict, laying out how power would be shared.

events.summary: The city is rebuilt as New Benalia from the white limestone of fallen buildings.
events.quote: Using the white limestone of fallen buildings, the city was rebuilt as New Benalia.

events.summary: The Cabal's expansion corrupts the great expanses of the empire.
events.quote: However, the expansion of The Cabal corrupted the great expanses of the empire.

events.summary: At the Oyster Bay summit Aron, found compleated, is killed by his daughter Danitha.
events.quote: Houses Capashen and Tarmula joined to rescue Aron, but when it was discovered that he had already been compleated, he was killed by his daughter, Danitha .

events.summary: After the second Phyrexian Invasion, Orvada's merchant lords make peace with Benalia and supply Lyra's Serran troops.
events.quote: After the second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the merchant lords of Orvada made peace with Benalia and furnished food and supplies to the Serran troops led by Lyra Dawnbringer.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, envy of House Capashen causes a civil war that drives them into the Cabal.
events.quote: Later, the various houses of Benalia began envying House Capashen, the mightiest at the time, leading to a civil war that forced the Capashens into hiding, eventually joining the Cabal .

Benalia (ben-AHL-ee-ah; demonym Benalish: BEN-ah-lish) is a powerful and long-lived nation on the continent of Aerona on Dominaria .
he was killed by his daughter, Danitha .
The current leader is Danitha Capashen , a young but ferocious knight.

relations.note: The raids aimed to destroy the Capashen bloodline.
relations.quote: It began with sporadic raids on the borderlands with the ultimate goal of destroying the bloodline of Clan Capashen

relations.note: She is the current leader of Clan Avenant, one of the seven houses.
relations.quote: The current leader is Cerise D'Avenant , who makes personal attendance at Council meetings while delegating daily affairs to her sisters.
